name: Exceptional Service Award (miniature medal body)
size_basis: Body width 0.625 in = the standard ribbon width for this size (1 3/8 in full, 5/8 in miniature; DoDM 1348.33 as relayed by the coordination chat, not verified locally); proportions from the McChord rasters (disc = ribbon width); CAPR 39-3 gives no medal dimensions. Height is the constructed body plus suspension ring.

ribbon_ref.note: medal body only; the ribbon asset supplies the stripes and devices. ribbon_attach is where the ribbon meets the suspension loop.

source: McChord rack-builder rasters in images/mini_medals/mcchord (measured: finish, body shape, ring position, emblem); no photographs used

fit.metric: constructed from measured proportions; compared by eye against the reference raster
fit.note: Shape-built art: rim, recessed band (lettering left blank), inner ring, raised emblem. Lettering only where legible in the reference.
